thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: several model load/warmup failures in us-west-2 serving cluster. metric spike: model_load_errors >5x baseline in 5m. Symptoms: warmup OOMs, deserialization exceptions, kernel compile timeouts. paging on-call.
Sasha: on it. which models?
incident-bot: impacted: redwood-model-xl-v2, redwood-model-large-quant. fallbacks used: redwood-model-medium. errors: "CUDA out of memory" during checkpoint load, "deserialization failed: unexpected tensor shape", "kernel compile timeout (30s)".
Sasha: grabbing logs. snippet:
Sasha: ```
[2025-09-10T14:23:45Z] model_loader ERROR deserialization failed: invalid tensor shape
[2025-09-10T14:23:45Z] runtime ERROR cudaMemoryAlloc failed: out of memory
[2025-09-10T14:23:46Z] compiler WARN kernel compile timeout (30s)
```
Leen: node-uw2-gpu-12 showing kubelet/container restart loop. probable OOM kills on warmup containers.
Sasha: are customers affected or just warmups? any 5xxs?
karen-support: support observed 5xx spikes for 8 customers; 2 enterprise tenants especially impacted by long-running batched pipelines.
Olivia: metrics confirm routing table in us-west-2 spilled traffic; warmup failures caused capacity dips so fallback couldn't absorb all traffic.
Alberto: immediate mitigations I suggest: 1) disable automatic warmup for xl-v2, 2) route new sessions to medium variant, 3) cordon the flapping node and drain.
Sasha: applying 1 and 2 now. patching rollout config to turn off warmup for xl-v2.
Sasha: ```json
PATCH /api/v1/deployments/rollout
{ "model": "redwood-model-xl-v2", "warmup": false }
```
incident-bot: rollout update accepted; warmup disabled for xl-v2 in us-west-2.
Sasha: switching routing policy to favor medium variant.
Sasha: ```
route-policy set --cluster us-west-2 --model redwood-model-xl-v2 --fallback redwood-model-medium --weight 0.0
```
Leen: cordoning node and draining.
Leen: ```
kubectl cordon node-uw2-gpu-12
kubectl drain node-uw2-gpu-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=5m
```
Alberto: compile timeouts are high; infra please flush compile cache or increase compile concurrency. infra-bot, ping infra on-call.
infra-bot: infra on-call paged (alberto). ETA ~10m.
Alberto: flushing compile-cache for us-west-2 now.
Alberto: ```
curl -XPOST https://compile-cache.us-west-2.internal/flush
```
Olivia: one warmup container repeatedly OOMed on a 32GB GPU. artifact checksum looks fine — suspect loader change introduced serialization incompatibility.
Sasha: verifying checksums for artifact and loader compatibility.
Sasha: ```
sha256sum /artifacts/redwood-xl-v2/checkpoint.tar.gz
# got 3f2d... expected 3f2d... OK
```
Sasha: since checksum OK, rolling runtime loader back to previous stable tag on affected nodes.
Leen: scheduling daemonset image rollback to runtime:2025-08-30.
Leen: ```
kubectl set image ds/realtime-runtime runtime=ghcr.io/redwood/runtime:2025-08-30 -n serving-us-west-2
```
incident-bot: runtime rollback job started.
Mike: I'm taking over on-call in ~20m. Sasha, give me the short state for handoff.
Sasha: short handoff -> cause unknown: mix of warmup OOMs, deserialization errors, and compile timeouts. Actions taken: warmup disabled for xl-v2, traffic routed to medium fallback, node-uw2-gpu-12 cordoned & draining, runtime rollback started, compile-cache flushed, scaled up medium hot-standby pool. Customer impact: 8 customers saw elevated 5xxs; two enterprise tenants had noticeable degradation; currently error rate reduced but not zero.
Mike: noted. escalate to oncall-sre if rollback doesn't reduce failures in 10m.
karen-support: preparing customer comms. draft status msg: "Investigating increased errors for several inference models in US-WEST-2. Temporary mitigations in progress. Some customers may see increased latency or 5xxs. Next update in 15 minutes."
Alberto: compile-cache flush brought kernel compile queue down ~70%.
Olivia: runtime rollback completed on 6/8 daemons; two nodes on older AMI blocking rollout until drained.
Leen: scaling medium pool +20 to absorb traffic while stabilizing.
Leen: ```
scale autoscaler --cluster us-west-2 --pool medium-hotstandby --delta +20
```
Sasha: post-mitigation check: model load failures dropped from ~120/min to ~6/min within 7m. improvement but still monitoring.
Mike: I'll keep this channel open. If >10/min or two enterprise tenants still degraded after next 15m, escalate and schedule customer bridge.
Sasha: filing postmortem ticket and leaving runbook notes: test deserialization permutations in CI, add artifact format checker in deploy pipeline, improve runtime memory accounting metrics, add alerting for kernel compile queue length. Creating incident record now.
Sasha: creating ticket INC-2025-4589 for postmortem and action items.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2025-4589 created. Postmortem owner: Sasha.
karen-support: sent initial status page update and notified affected POCs. one POC asked for ETA; gave 30-60m estimate.
Mike: 10m check: rollback completed; error rate ~5/min; enterprise errors reduced to single digits. handing to night oncall at 18:00 PST. Monitoring continues.
Olivia: follow-ups added: unit tests for deserialization edge cases, verify model artifact formats in CI, improve compile-cache observability.
Sasha: thanks everyone. drafting postmortem after stabilization. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: channel will auto-check in 15 minutes or on status change.
